notes: Articles are on latinanoticias.pe (the news portal of Latina Television; latina.pe itself only carries /programas/ episode pages, 11/7/14 per day, no news). robots.txt (allowed, no * disallow) declares /_files/sitemaps/sitemap_index.xml -> one sitemap per MONTH, 106 files 2018/01..2026/10; no per-day sitemap and no date archive (/2026/10/10/, /fecha/..., /_files/sitemaps/2026/10/10.xml all 404), and query params are robots-disallowed (Disallow: /*?). So the day is picked by <lastmod> (== publication time, 20-45 posts/day, 32/26/40 on 09-30/10-10/10-20) and every <loc> also carries its own date as a _YYYYMMDD suffix, so a caller can re-split exactly by URL date. Careful: quiet Sundays fall under 15 (2026-10-11 had 8 by lastmod, 14 by URL date) - a real data property, not a fetch failure. Article pages render 3.4k-5.7k chars of text server-side.
